_comment: thinktank.json — shared style definition for the Think-Tank style.
Formal two-column layout with forest-green accent. Clean, authoritative,
suitable for policy briefs and research reports.
md_harden reads 'hardening' when --style thinktank is passed.
md2pdf engines read 'design' for reference; rendering is in the .typ/.css files.

design._comment: Rendering decisions — implemented in thinktank.typ and style_thinktank.css.

_comment: Conventions that md_harden enforces when --style thinktank is passed.
Think-tank style uses capitalised Source: to match formal policy report
citation conventions. Two-column layout same as intelligence style.
et al. italics at moderate confidence — policy reports vary.

pull_quote_attribution._comment: Think-tank style uses capitalised Source: — matches formal report citations.
pull_quote_attribution.action: Normalise 'source:' -> 'Source:'. Capitalised form matches policy report convention.

et_al_italics._comment: Moderate confidence — policy reports often cite without italics in footnotes.
